author: _DipperPines
body:
Hey Guys!

Today I am presenting my newest map: Fireball Escape!

This map is a recreation of the minigame on Mineplex called Dragon Escape. And no, this is not an advertisement. I spent a lot of time on it and I am proud of it. Hope you enjoy it!

Download And Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aaRiwNI9el4&feature=youtu.be

If anyone wants to record it with me, message me on skype! It's somewhere bellow.
